transcript.en: Hello, Junior Cycle camp, Jake speaking.
transcript.zh: 你好，这里是青少年自行车度假营，我是Jake。

transcript.en: Hi. I'm calling for some information about the cycle camp - I'm thinking of sending my son.
transcript.zh: 你好，我想在电话里了解一下关于自行车度假营的信息，我正在考虑送我儿子去参加。

transcript.en: Great. Well, it's held every weekday morning over the summer vacation and we focus on basic cycling skills and safety.
transcript.zh: 好的，在暑假期间，度假营在每个工作日早上开展。我们关注的是自行车骑行中的技术和安全。

transcript.en: We have eight levels for children from three years upwards. How old's your son?
transcript.zh: 针对三岁以上的孩子，我们设定了八个级别，你家孩子多大了？

transcript.en: Charlie? He's seven. He can ride a bike, but he needs a little more training before he's safe to go on the road.
transcript.zh: Charlie吗，他七岁了，他会骑自行车，但是需要更多的训练才能安全上路。

transcript.en: He'd probably be best in Level 5.They start off practising on the site here, and we aim to get them riding on the road,
transcript.zh: 他可能最适合被安排在第五级。这个级别的训练开始是在这个场地，最终目的是让孩子们在路上骑行

transcript.en: but first they're taken to ride in the park, away from the traffic.
transcript.zh: 但起初为了避开车辆，孩子们会被带到公园去骑车。

transcript.en: Right. And can you tell me a bit about the instructors?
transcript.zh: 好的，你能给我介绍一下教练员吗？

transcript.en: Well, all our staff wear different coloured shirts.
transcript.zh: 没问题，我们所有的员工都穿不同颜色的衬衫。

transcript.en: So, we have three supervisors,and they have red shirts.They support the instructors, and they also stand in for me if I'm not around.
transcript.zh: 我们有三个指导员，他们穿红色衬衫。他们负责协助教练员。另外，如果我不在这，他们也会接替我的职务。

transcript.en: Then the instructors themselves are in blue shirts, and one of these is responsible for each class.
transcript.zh: 教练员穿蓝色衬衫，他们每个人负责一个班级。

transcript.en: OK.
transcript.zh: 明白了。

transcript.en: In order to be accepted, all our instructors have to submit a reference from someone who's seen them work with children-
transcript.zh: 想要成为我们教练员的所有人都必须要提交介绍信，提供介绍信的人是需要能证明教练员之前的工作是和小朋友相关的，

transcript.en: like if they've worked as a babysitter, for example.
transcript.zh: 比如说他们曾经是临时保姆之类的。

transcript.en: Then they have to complete our training course, including how to do lesson plans,and generally care for the well-being of the kids in their class.
transcript.zh: 另外他们需要完成我们的培训课程，比如如何做课程计划以及如何在课堂中照顾到孩子们的健康。

transcript.en: They do a great job, I have to say.
transcript.zh: 不得不说，他们都完成的很出色。

transcript.en: Right. And tell me a bit about the classes. What size will Charlie's class be?
transcript.zh: 好的，然后给我介绍一下班级情况吧。Charlie的班级是多大的规模呢？

transcript.en: We have a limit of eight children in each class, so their instructor really gets to know them well.
transcript.zh: 我们每个班级的上限是八个同学，这样教练员可以更好了解每个学员。

transcript.en: They're out riding most of the time but they have quiet times too, where their instructor might tell them a story that's got something to do with cycling,or get them to play a game together.
transcript.zh: 大部分时间他们出去骑行，当然他们也有休息时间，休息的时候教练可能会跟他们讲关于自行车骑行的故事，或者安排大家一起做游戏。

transcript.en: It's a lot of fun.
transcript.zh: 非常有意思。

transcript.en: It must be. Now, what happens if there's rain? Do the classes still run?
transcript.zh: 我也觉得，那么，下雨天怎么办，课程仍然进行吗？

transcript.en: Oh yes. We don't let that put us off - we just put on our waterproofs and keep cycling.
transcript.zh: 是的，我们不会因为下雨取消课程，我们会穿着防水服继续骑行。

transcript.en: And is there anything special Charlie should bring along with him?
transcript.zh: 有什么特别需要Charlie带着的吗？

transcript.en: Well, maybe some spare clothes, especially if the weather's not so good. And a snack for break time.
transcript.zh: 可能需要额外带点衣服，尤其是天气不好的时候，另外还要带一些休息时候吃的零食。

transcript.en: How about a drink?
transcript.zh: 需要带喝的吗？

transcript.en: No, we'll provide that. And make sure he has shoes, not sandals.
transcript.zh: 不用，我们会提供。而且要确保他穿的是鞋，而不是凉鞋。

transcript.en: Sure.And just at present Charlie has to take medication every few hours, so I'll make sure he has that.
transcript.zh: 好的，现在Charlie需要每隔几个小时吃一些药，所以我会给他带一点药。

transcript.en: Absolutely. Just give us details of when he has to take it and we'll make sure he does.
transcript.zh: 没问题，告诉我们他一般什么时候需要吃药，我们会提醒他吃药。

transcript.en: Thanks.
transcript.zh: 谢谢。

transcript.en: Now, there are a few things you should know about Day 1 of the camp.
transcript.zh: 嗯，还有一些关于这个度假营的第一天的注意事项。

transcript.en: The classes normally start at 9.30 every morning, but on Day 1 you should aim to get Charlie here by 9.20.
transcript.zh: 课程通常是在每天早上9：30开始，但是在第一天你需要让查理在9:20前到达地点。

transcript.en: The finishing time will be 12.30 as usual.
transcript.zh: 早上通常结束的时间是12:30，

transcript.en: We need the additional time because there are a few extra things to do. The most important is that we have a very careful check to make sure that every child's helmet fits properly.
transcript.zh: 我们需要额外的时间，因为有一些其他的事情要去做。最重要的是我们要仔细的去检查，以确保每个孩子的头盔是合适的。

transcript.en: If it doesn't fit, we'll try to adjust it,or well find him another one - but he must wear it all the time he's on the bike.
transcript.zh: 如果头盔不合适，我们需要去调整或者是给他换其他的，但是在他骑自行车的时候，必须要全程带着头盔。

transcript.en: Of course.
transcript.zh: 嗯，一定。

transcript.en: Then after that, all the instructors will be waiting to meet their classes,and they'll meet up in the tent - you can't miss it.
transcript.zh: 在那之后，教练员会等着他的学员们上课，他们会在帐篷里见面，你肯定能看到那个帐篷。

transcript.en: And each instructor will take their class away and get started. OK. Well that all sounds good.
transcript.zh: 然后每一个教练带着他班上的孩子离开帐篷，开始他们的练习。嗯，感觉很不错。

transcript.en: Now can you tell me how much the camp costs a week?
transcript.zh: 现在可以告诉我这个度假营每周的价格吗？

transcript.en: One hundred ninety-nine dollars.We've managed to keep the price more or less the same as last year - it was one hundred ninety then.
transcript.zh: 199美元一周，我们需要确保价格是和去年差不多的，去年是一周190美元。

transcript.en: But the places are filling up quite quickly.
transcript.zh: 但是目前名额正在迅速被占。

transcript.en: Right.Ok,well I'd like to book for....
transcript.zh: 好的，我想预定……
